packet.verseText: “I watched until thrones were placed, and one who was Ancient of Days sat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool. His throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.

availableCast.name: One like a son of man

scene.primarySubject: Blazing throne of fire and burning wheels, with radiance and fire rising around it
scene.action: Thrones are being set in place as fire pours outward and flames burn along the wheels
scene.setting: A vast luminous expanse of cloud and fire filling the sky above the vision
scene.secondaryElements: Drifting white cloud, rolling flame and pale light spreading across the heavens; no other figures shown at this instant
scene.mood: Awe-filled, solemn and majestic, with a sense of holy judgment approaching
scene.timeOfDay: Night vision with deep dusk light, the pale glow of the throne-fire brightening the cloud
scene.composition: Wide, high viewpoint looking up into the heavens, the fiery throne centered and the cloud sweeping outward on all sides

packet.verseText: It will happen, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a cleft of the rock, and will cover you with my hand until I have passed by;

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Moses pressed into a narrow cleft in the rock face, sheltered and crouched low.
scene.action: Radiant glory of cloud and fire sweeps past the mountain while Moses remains hidden in the stone.
scene.setting: Rocky wilderness slopes of Horeb beneath the summit, a cleft in towering stone, dry scrub and sand below.
scene.secondaryElements: Shepherd's staff resting on the rock beside him; wind-driven cloud and a glow of fire streaming across the sky above the summit.
scene.mood: Awe, reverence and quiet protection, solemn rather than spectacular.
scene.timeOfDay: Early dusk deepening into twilight, still air giving way to rising wind and low drifting cloud.
scene.composition: Low viewpoint looking up at the cleft; Moses small and framed within the stone, the glowing cloud sweeping across the upper sky.

packet.verseText: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

availableCast.name: The Israelite people (the children of Israel)
God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: A barren rocky mountain, its summit and slopes enveloped in billowing smoke and glowing fire.
scene.action: Smoke rises from the mountain like a furnace, and the whole mountain shakes violently with thunder and fire.
scene.setting: A stark desert wilderness at the foot of Mount Sinai, with the Israelite camp spread across the sand below.
scene.secondaryElements: Israelite people gathered at the lower slopes, some shielding their eyes or bowing low as dust rises around them.
scene.mood: Awe, fear and reverent trembling in the face of overwhelming holy power.
scene.timeOfDay: Late day sliding into dusk, with thunder-dark clouds and dust in the air.
scene.composition: A wide view from the lower slope looking up at the smoking mountain, with the people in the foreground and the summit filling the upper frame.

packet.verseText: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Isaiah, a man in a plain tunic and cloak, standing still with his face lifted toward the light
scene.action: Brilliant light and cloud pour outward through the sanctuary, its hem spreading across the hall until the whole temple seems filled with it
scene.setting: A lofty stone temple hall in Jerusalem with massive pillars and a raised sanctuary before the inner shrine
scene.secondaryElements: Incense smoke curling upward, an altar glowing with flame-light, priestly attendants in linen at the edges, and the mighty hem of radiance flowing across the stone floor
scene.mood: Awe, reverence and trembling wonder, grounded and solemn
scene.timeOfDay: Dusk inside the temple, with fading daylight through high openings mingling with lamplight and flame-light
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from the temple floor looking up toward the raised sanctuary, Isaiah in the lower foreground, the glowing presence filling the upper space and the pillars framing the scene

packet.verseText: Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Moses standing upright on the summit, holding the two stone tablets against his chest
scene.action: A dense cloud descends and surrounds Moses, with soft radiance moving through it as God's presence stands with him.
scene.setting: Bare granite rocks at the summit of the wilderness mountain, dry stone falling away into a lower valley.
scene.secondaryElements: Plain woven tunic and cloak on Moses; cloud and pale radiance drifting over the rocks; no other people present.
scene.mood: Reverent, solemn and quiet, with awe and nearness.
scene.timeOfDay: Early morning, soft pale light, still dry desert air.
scene.composition: Moses seen from a low angle against the rising cloud, the summit filling the middle ground and the valley fading below.

packet.verseText: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Ezekiel kneeling or standing on the riverbank, looking up in awe
scene.action: Radiant light and fire gather in a shining, throne-like form above the sapphire-blue expanse, with no visible figure within it
scene.setting: Reed-lined bank of the Chebar canal beside a mud-brick settlement in Babylonian exile
scene.secondaryElements: Four winged living creatures beneath the expanse, their wings lowered; amber fire and cloud rising from the north; river reeds bent by wind
scene.mood: Awe, reverence and tense wonder
scene.timeOfDay: Dawn brightening into daylight, clear air with a rising storm wind
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from the riverbank looking upward, Ezekiel small in the lower frame, the expanse and radiant throne-light filling the upper frame

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel
The Israelite people (the children of Israel)

scene.primarySubject: A tall pillar of cloud standing at the door of the portable tabernacle, faintly lit from within.
scene.action: Aaron and Miriam step forward together from the threshold area toward the cloud while Moses stands nearby.
scene.setting: Desert camp at Hazeroth with goat-hair tents and the tabernacle at the center, wilderness beyond.
scene.secondaryElements: Aaron in priestly linen garments, Miriam in a plain woven dress and head covering, Moses in a woven cloak, and onlooking Israelites in the tents' edges.
scene.mood: Tense, solemn and awed, with a hush over the gathered camp.
scene.timeOfDay: Late afternoon fading toward dusk under still dry desert air.
scene.composition: Wide view from the camp side, the cloud pillar and tabernacle door centered, the three figures arranged across the foreground.}
